title: One pendulum, four lengths
note: The school practical: the same pendulum filmed at four string lengths, each clip measured on its own. Each length is the one measured with a tape (here the renders’ true lengths), and each period is the one Ansatz measured from the swing; the slope of L against T² gives g, as in the NCERT experiment. No tape? The A4 sheet on the wall gives the lengths instead, within about 6%. These clips are rendered with a true g of 9.81 m/s², so the answer can be checked.
tapeNote: Tape lengths here are the renders’ true lengths, standing in for a student’s metre scale.
